title: Vakter threat-feed — phishing-domains.txt (post-parse shape)
description: phishing-domains.txt is a line-delimited text file with '#' comments. After parsing (strip comments, strip blanks, split on first whitespace), each row matches this schema. Canonical spec: openspec/changes/vakter-watch-pivot/specs/threat-feed/bundle-schema.md

domain.description: Lowercase ASCII (or punycode for IDN). eTLD+1 or deeper. No bare TLDs, no IPs.

first_seen.description: Optional first-seen date from trailing '# first-seen YYYY-MM-DD' comment.
